v1_boundary.ProtTox-3DKD v1: immutable strict baseline; no code/checkpoint modification

question: Is a lightweight peptide-specific encoder representation (PepBERT-small/large, UniParc) better than the current frozen ProtT5 representation under the same TriStat+PhysChem+MLP protocol?

feature_contract.tokenization: official PepBERT usage: [SOS] + character ids + [EOS], [PAD]-padded batches with PAD masked in encoder attention
feature_contract.residue_extraction: drop SOS/EOS, keep exactly len(sequence) residue embeddings
feature_contract.pooling: identical ghxtox tristat_pool: masked mean, max, population std over residues

training.protocol: exact existing ProtTox-TSK MLP pipeline (scripts/train_prottox_tsk.py), reused unchanged for B/C
training.head: TriStatMLPHead: LayerNorm -> Linear(192) -> GELU -> Dropout(0.10) -> Linear(1)
training.batch: full-batch per epoch, exactly as existing A runs

metrics.reference_context: ProtTox-3DKD v1 OOF MCC 0.82631 / AUPRC 0.94294 / Brier 0.05764 is context only; not the shootout gate

continue_gate.baseline: A0 no-KD TriStat-MLP mean over seeds 20260905/20260906

per_candidate_requirements.improvement_metric: at least one of mean MCC increase, mean AUPRC increase, or mean Brier decrease

continue_gate.fold_stability_report: report 5-fold and 2-seed detail; do not post-hoc select folds
continue_gate.decision: If B or C passes, continue with AMT-PepTox design on the better encoder only. If neither passes, stop the PepBERT representation line and do not spend further effort.

promotion_gate_for_product: not applicable; this is a representation diagnostic, not a product replacement. ProtTox-3DKD v1 remains the deployment baseline.
